Name: Soft's Void Chicken Recolor
Author: softfragile
Description:
Recolor of a few void chicken-related items!
This is my first time coding and modding, will highly appreciate any feedback!
I’ve got nothing against the original colors, but sometimes a space chicken seems more fitting to the "void" tittle—
[b]
Installing
[/b]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI
2. Install the latest version of Content Patche
r3. Unzip file and move to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
4. Run the game with SMAPIThat’s it, should work alright!
